$comment: Every change we make to the source content. Applied by scripts/content/build-content-db.ts and listed in docs/content-changes.md. Ids are SOURCE ids (category id, dhikr id inside that category).

categorySplits.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-16: morning and evening adhkar are separate categories.

parts.removeReason: The evening wording notes [وإذا أمسى قال: ...] are removed from the morning text. Nothing is added.

textFixes.find: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

textFixes.find: اللَّهُـمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ:فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
textFixes.replace: اللَّهم إني أسألك خير هذه الليلة: فتحها، ونصرها، ونورها، وبركتها، وهداها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما فيها، وشر ما بعدها

addedAdhkar.evidence: The owner's own words, not from the book. No source, no audio yet.

removeQuoteMarks.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-22: the book wraps quoted words in (( )); they are not needed. Single parentheses (notes such as (ثلاث مرات)) stay.

lineBreaks.reason: Each part of a long dhikr on its own line: each surah, the isti'adha and the verse after it, the step after a verse, and the steps of a list.

audioRepeats.reason: How many times the dhikr is said in one recording (owner, 2026-10-23). A recording not listed says it once. Key: the audio file name (npm run db:peek shows it).

audioRecordings.reason: The owner's own recordings of the morning and evening adhkar (milestone 11, 2026-10-31), as recorded (m4a, not converted); a dhikr not listed plays the book's.
